children: Renewed agreement positions the Company to expand customer adoption and recurring subscription revenue

("Visionstate" or the "Company") is pleased to announces that it has signed an amendment extending its distribution agreement with Bunzl Canada Inc. ("Bunzl") through December 31, 2027, strengthening an established channel for expanding CleanWatch™ adoption and growing recurring revenue.

The renewed agreement combines Visionstate's facility-management technology with Bunzl's customer relationships and national sales team. It formally incorporates the CleanWatch™ brand and updates the product pricing schedules, supporting continued sales of the platform and its subscription-based modules.

The agreement provides Visionstate with an ongoing monthly payment in addition to its share of CleanWatch™ subscription revenue. This structure provides a recurring revenue base, with opportunities for growth as new customers adopt the platform and existing customers add functionality. Bunzl's national sales team extends the product's reach to facility-management customers across Canada.

"This partnership combines an established recurring revenue base with the opportunity to grow subscription revenue through Bunzl's national sales team," said John Putters, CEO of Visionstate. "We are seeing strong interest from facility managers who want clear evidence that work has been completed and better information to manage their operations. Our focus is on supporting Bunzl's team, converting that interest into installations and increasing adoption of CleanWatch™ across Canada."

CleanWatch™ gives facility managers tools to verify cleaning and service activities, conduct inspections, manage work orders and monitor performance. By replacing paper records and fragmented processes with accessible digital information, the platform helps customers strengthen accountability and make more informed operational decisions.

New installations and the adoption of additional subscription-based modules create opportunities to increase revenue from both new and existing customers. The modular offering allows customers to expand their use of CleanWatch™ as their operational needs evolve.

Recent Bunzl Innovation Shows in Calgary and Edmonton generated prospective customer opportunities and valuable feedback from facility-management teams. Visionstate intends to work closely with Bunzl to advance these opportunities through demonstrations, targeted follow-up and customer engagement.

is a technology company focused on compliance-driven subscription solutions for regulated and high-traffic facilities.
